heroes.note_en: Drives 44 minutes each way to King Hussein Business Park every workday; the fuel rise pushes him over the line, and the cash-for-riders fix leaves him there
heroes.note_ar: يقود سيارته 44 دقيقة في كل اتجاه إلى مجمع الملك الحسين للأعمال كل يوم عمل؛ رفع الوقود يدفعه فوق الحد، والدعم الموجّه للركاب لا يصل إليه

heroes._why: Kept on purpose: the engine's best grid fix targets riders (cash for no-car people + a bus-fare freeze); it does not reach middle-income drivers. On stage this is the honest 'who does the fix still miss?' moment.
